101.description: Japanese anime director, known for Attack on Titan and Death Note at Madhouse and Wit Studio.

102.description: Japanese anime director, helmed Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood at Bones studio.

103.description: Japanese manga writer, creator of Death Note serialized in Weekly Shonen Jump.

104.description: Legendary animator and co-founder of Studio Ghibli; directed Spirited Away and My Neighbor Totoro.

105.description: Manga artist and creator of Berserk, one of the most influential dark fantasy manga series.

106.description: Creator of One Piece, the best-selling manga of all time with over 500 million copies in circulation.

107.description: Creator of Naruto, serialized in Weekly Shonen Jump from 1999 to 2014.

108.description: Manga artist, creator of Your Lie in April serialized in Monthly Shonen Magazine.

109.description: Prolific composer known for powerful orchestral anime soundtracks including Attack on Titan.

110.description: Celebrated composer for Cowboy Bebop, Ghost in the Shell: SAC, and Macross Plus.

111.description: Legendary composer, long-time collaborator of Hayao Miyazaki and Studio Ghibli.

112.description: Light novel author and anime series composition writer, known for Full Metal Panic!.

113.description: Director of Your Name and Weathering With You, known for breathtaking visual style and romantic themes.

114.description: Series composition writer for Code Geass, Guilty Crown, and many acclaimed anime productions.

115.description: Animation director known for detailed character animation work on several prominent anime series.
